PRO MASTERS / PRODUCER LAB

Your finishing room,
built around the beat.

Practical tools for beatmakers, vocal producers and engineers: prepare clean premixes, make repeatable decisions and deliver sessions with confidence.

01 / BEAT DELIVERY

Client-ready exports

Trim dead space, set clean fades, compare the source and master, and export a clearly named audio deliverable.

02 / GAIN STAGING

Leave room to master

Keep premixes free of clipping and avoid pushing every channel to the ceiling. A sensible starting point is peaks around -6 dBFS before mastering; use your ears and the session meter.

03 / VOCAL FINISH

Presence without harshness

Use modest presence and de-essing. If consonants become dull or the vocal sounds lisped, back off the de-esser; mastering cannot replace a well-balanced vocal mix.

04 / REFERENCE CHECK

Compare like for like

Use level-matched A/B playback. Match the reference section and perceived loudness before judging bass, vocal level, width or punch.

05 / SESSION ORGANIZATION

Repeatable delivery routine

Keep a premaster, a reference, a final master and a revision copy. Save custom mastering presets for repeatable starting points.

06 / LOW-LATENCY PREVIEW

Responsive browser monitoring

Live preview runs through the Web Audio API. Actual latency depends on the browser, audio device and operating system; use a wired interface and a smaller buffer in your system settings when possible.

HELP CENTER

Questions, answered.

How the studio works, what is free, and what to expect from your exports.

Is Master Pro really free?

Yes. Core mastering, playback, presets and A/B preview are available free. The free export allowance is shown in your account area. MP4 visualizer export is free and does not consume your audio-master credits.

Are my tracks uploaded?

No. Audio is decoded and processed locally by your browser. The site does not send your audio to a remote mastering service. Your device's memory and browser capabilities affect maximum file size and processing time.

Why can a large file take a while?

Uncompressed audio can be much larger in memory than its source file. Long tracks and video soundtrack extraction require more memory. Keep the tab open, avoid opening several projects at once, and use WAV/MP3 when video extraction is not needed.

Can I export MP4 for free?

Yes. Video visualizer exports are free and do not consume audio-master credits. They include the studio logo. Your browser chooses a supported video container; some browsers produce WebM rather than MP4.

Does the logo appear on every video?

The built-in studio logo is embedded in visualizer exports. You can still add your own cover artwork from the export panel where supported.

What does the mastering chain do?

It applies the controls you choose, including tone shaping, dynamics, stereo width, saturation and peak limiting. The Vocal Clarity profile uses a modest presence lift and light de-essing as a starting point. It cannot isolate a vocal from a stereo mix; use stems for independent vocal processing. Presets are starting points, not automatic guarantees. Always compare at matched loudness and listen on more than one playback system.

Will it make every mix sound professional?

No tool can guarantee that. Mastering cannot fully repair clipping, distortion, arrangement issues or a poor recording. A clean premaster with headroom gives the processor more room to work.

Which files can I use?

Audio support depends on the browser decoder and includes common formats such as WAV, MP3, M4A, AAC, OGG and FLAC. MP4/MOV/WebM video imports attempt local soundtrack extraction and codec support varies.

Can I use the exports commercially?

You retain rights to your own audio and are responsible for any samples, beats, vocals, artwork or other material you include. Master Pro does not grant rights to third-party content.

How do accounts work?

This standalone version can save a local profile on this device, but it does not provide secure cloud accounts or cross-device syncing. A production account system requires a backend and authentication provider.

A better master, without the mystery.

Quick answers before you start.

Can I use Master Pro completely free?

Yes. The mastering controls, live preview, A/B comparison and presets built into the app are available to try free. The free plan includes 2 exports. Pro plans add unlimited exports, premium file settings and video export.

Do I need to create an account?

No account is needed to load, preview or master a track. Your audio is processed locally in your browser and is not uploaded to a mastering server.

Can I upload an MP4 or MOV?

Yes, in supported browsers. Master Pro extracts the soundtrack locally, then loads it into the mastering studio. Video codec support varies by browser; Chrome or Edge is recommended.

Will every track sound professional automatically?

Every mix is different. Start with Balanced or Streaming Safe, listen on headphones and speakers, and use the Original/Master buttons at matched volume. A loudness target is a guide, not a guarantee of platform approval or a substitute for a mastering engineer.
